```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Read the extracted baby name data for Andrew
andrew_data <- read_csv("Andrew.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Male Andrews Over the Years

```{r}
#| label: male-andrews-plot
# Prepare male data with formatted hover tooltips
male_andrews <- andrew_data |>
  filter(sex == "M") |>
  mutate(hover = paste0("<b>Year:</b> ", year, "<br><b>Babies:</b> ", scales::comma(n)))

# Create warm, stylized ggplot
p_male <- ggplot(male_andrews, aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(aes(text = hover, group = 1), color = "#3b6978", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(male_andrews, year %in% c(1960, 1987, 1993)),
    aes(text = hover),
    color = "#c05c46",
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of Andrew for Boys",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#edeae1")
  )

# Add clean callout badges with arrows pointing to key milestones
ggplotly(p_male, tooltip = "text") |>
  add_annotations(
    x = 1960, y = 8201,
    text = "<b>1960 Spike</b><br>Birth of UK Prince Andrew",
    showarrow = TRUE, arrowhead = 2, arrowsize = 0.7, arrowcolor = "#c05c46",
    ax = -45, ay = -45,
    bgcolor = "#fdfbf7", bordercolor = "#d9cbb8", borderwidth = 1, borderpad = 4,
    font = list(size = 11, color = "#2d3748")
  ) |>
  add_annotations(
    x = 1987, y = 36206,
    text = "<b>1987 Peak (36,206)</b><br>Royal wedding & 80s Brat Pack",
    showarrow = TRUE, arrowhead = 2, arrowsize = 0.7, arrowcolor = "#c05c46",
    ax = 0, ay = -50,
    bgcolor = "#fdfbf7", bordercolor = "#d9cbb8", borderwidth = 1, borderpad = 4,
    font = list(size = 11, color = "#2d3748")
  ) |>
  add_annotations(
    x = 1993, y = 27326,
    text = "<b>1993 Dip</b><br>After Category 5 Hurricane Andrew",
    showarrow = TRUE, arrowhead = 2, arrowsize = 0.7, arrowcolor = "#c05c46",
    ax = 45, ay = 35,
    bgcolor = "#fdfbf7", bordercolor = "#d9cbb8", borderwidth = 1, borderpad = 4,
    font = list(size = 11, color = "#2d3748")
  )
```

## Yes there are female andrews too

```{r}
#| label: female-andrews-plot
# Prepare female data with formatted hover tooltips
female_andrews <- andrew_data |>
  filter(sex == "F") |>
  mutate(hover = paste0("<b>Year:</b> ", year, "<br><b>Babies:</b> ", scales::comma(n)))

# Create warm, stylized ggplot for female Andrews
p_female <- ggplot(female_andrews, aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(aes(text = hover, group = 1), color = "#b85d77", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(female_andrews, year == 1987),
    aes(text = hover),
    color = "#884964",
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Yes there are female andrews too",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#edeae1")
  )

# Add clean callout badge pointing to the peak
ggplotly(p_female, tooltip = "text") |>
  add_annotations(
    x = 1987, y = 223,
    text = "<b>1987 Peak (223 babies)</b><br>Andrew mania reached baby girls!",
    showarrow = TRUE, arrowhead = 2, arrowsize = 0.7, arrowcolor = "#884964",
    ax = 0, ay = -45,
    bgcolor = "#fdfbf7", bordercolor = "#e5cfd6", borderwidth = 1, borderpad = 4,
    font = list(size = 11, color = "#2d3748")
  )
```
